mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalBatches, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE inspection_result = '合格') AS qualifiedBatches, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE inspection_result = '不合格') AS unqualifiedBatches, ROUND( CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE inspection_result = '合格') * 100.0 / COUNT(*) END, 2 ) AS qualifiedRate, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE review_status = '待审核') AS pendingReviewCount, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_urgent = '是') AS urgentCount FROM qms.material_inspection WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND plant_code = #{plantCode}

SELECT defect_desc AS defectDesc, COUNT(*) AS count FROM qms.material_inspection WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND plant_code = #{plantCode} AND defect_desc IS NOT NULL AND defect_desc != '' GROUP BY defect_desc ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT supplier_name AS supplierName, supplier_code AS supplierCode, COUNT(*) AS totalBatches, ROUND( COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE inspection_result = '合格') * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2 ) AS passRate FROM qms.material_inspection WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND plant_code = #{plantCode} AND supplier_code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY supplier_name, supplier_code ORDER BY totalBatches DESC

SELECT TO_CHAR(inspection_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS date, COUNT(*) AS totalBatches, ROUND( COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE inspection_result = '合格') * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2 ) AS passRate FROM qms.material_inspection WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND plant_code = #{plantCode} AND inspection_date >= CURRENT_DATE - 30 GROUP BY TO_CHAR(inspection_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') ORDER BY date

SELECT supplier_code AS supplierCode, supplier_name AS supplierName, COUNT(*) AS totalBatches, ROUND( COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE inspection_result = '合格') * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2 ) AS passRate FROM qms.material_inspection WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND plant_code = #{plantCode} AND supplier_code IS NOT NULL AND inspection_date >= CURRENT_DATE - 30 GROUP BY supplier_code, supplier_name ORDER BY totalBatches DESC LIMIT 5

WITH top5 AS ( SELECT supplier_code, supplier_name FROM qms.material_inspection WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND plant_code = #{plantCode} AND supplier_code IS NOT NULL AND inspection_date >= CURRENT_DATE - 30 GROUP BY supplier_code, supplier_name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 5 ), ds AS ( SELECT generate_series(CURRENT_DATE - 29, CURRENT_DATE, '1 day')::date AS d ) SELECT t.supplier_code AS supplierCode, t.supplier_name AS supplierName, TO_CHAR(ds.d, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS date, ROUND( COUNT(m.id) FILTER (WHERE m.inspection_result = '合格') * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(m.id), 0), 2 ) AS passRate FROM top5 t CROSS JOIN ds LEFT JOIN qms.material_inspection m ON m.supplier_code = t.supplier_code AND m.is_deleted = 0 AND m.plant_code = #{plantCode} AND m.inspection_date = ds.d GROUP BY t.supplier_code, t.supplier_name, ds.d ORDER BY t.supplier_code, ds.d
